Join community here: https://discord.gg/6mQYYfFMAn"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Treg (OpenRouter for Tools)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**OpenRouter, but for agent tools instead of models.** Point an agent at one base URL with one token"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"
and it can do the job: **a curated catalog of thousands of endpoints across many providers** — SEO "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"and backlinks,
social and trends, people and company enrichment, ads, scraping, image and video gene"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"ration —
**priced per call, from a cent**,
with no provider signup. Plus your own team's keys, skill"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"s and CLIs, callable by every teammate's
agent without the credential ever leaving the server."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Ask for the task, not the tool.** You do not need to know which vendor sells backlink data, or to
"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"hold an account with them. Search for what you want to do, read the price, call it."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Built for the Superdesign team, live at treg.to — anyone can self-host."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why it exists"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The tools an agent needs for real work sit behind subscriptions nobody buys for a single run —
Semru"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"sh $139/mo, Moz $99/mo, Crunchbase $99/mo, Apollo $59/seat — behind signup walls, or behind no
publi"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"c API at all (invite-only, partner-only, app-review-only). treg carries those accounts and
bills fra"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ctions of a cent per call."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Two kinds of tool, one token"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **The catalog** — external endpoints treg can serve with its own key or through a verified public
"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"route that needs no provider key. Own-key calls use the team's prepaid balance; anonymous calls
are "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"free. No account with the provider is needed. New verified accounts receive **$1.00 free**
once, whe"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"n they create an eligible team.
- **Your own tools** — anything a teammate registered: a paid API ac"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"count, an OAuth connection, a
vendor CLI, a `SKILL.md`. **Your own key always wins over treg's, and "},{"id":"p9s6","text":"those calls are never
metered.**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The vocabulary for the second half:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **tool** = something the registry calls for you with the org's credential. Two kinds:
- **endpoint"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"** — an upstream `base_url` + credential **bindings** (each binding injects one
secret into the requ"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"est; a request can carry several, e.g. an OAuth bearer *and* a
`developer-token` header).
- **CLI** "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"— a vendor binary (`stripe`, `gh`, `vercel`, ...) run with the credential injected.
- **skill / bund"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"le** = a recipe (`SKILL.md`) + its secrets + its tool(s), registered together."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**The one rule:** the proxy **relays, never models** the upstream, and **injects auth server-side**
"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"— so it survives upstream API changes and callers never hold keys."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"# Part 1 · Using the registry"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Visit **treg.to** (hosted on Render) — the dashboard,
sign-in, and every URL below live there."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Quickstart"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Same flow as the dashboard's **Getting started** guide:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Fish Audio provides S2.1 Pro speech, public-voice discovery, and private voice cloning.
Speech is bi"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"nary stdout, so redirect it to a file. A discovered voice's `_id` or a team voice id is
the TTS `ref"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"erence_id`; voices created on treg's Fish account are durable team resources:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"With your own Fish key, requests remain an unrestricted, unmetered upstream relay and Fish owns the
"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"h key, requests remain an unrestricted, unmetered upstream relay and Fish owns the
account boundary."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Catalog tool inputs are described by `treg catalog get <id>`. Tools marked `strict_query` reject und"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"eclared or repeated query parameters, unsupported values and request bodies."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Your token identifies you on every call (`X-Treg-Token` header) and is the same for all tools.
Disco"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ver what your team has shared: `treg tool ls` · check credential health: `treg health`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Or install it as a Claude Code plugin"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Installs the treg skill and treg's tools with no token and no configuration. Run `/mcp`, pick
treg a"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"nd sign in; the tools appear after it. Other agents: `npx skills add superdesigndev/treg -s treg`
(o"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"r see Workflow skills for the rest).
See docs/CLAUDE-PLUGIN.md. MiniMax Code / MiniMax Agent users: "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"the same
skill ships via the MiniMax Plugin Marketplace (docs/MINIMAX-PLUGIN.md)."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Workflow skills"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Ready-made recipes your agent runs end to end, every call through treg:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Skill | What your agent can do |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"**Request flow for `/call`:** resolve tool (by URL host + longest `base_url` prefix, or by name) →
d"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ecrypt its secret(s) → apply each binding's injector → stream to the upstream → fire-and-forget
audi"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"t record. The infra relay streams bytes without business logic. The call application buffers
respons"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"es needing settlement or ownership evidence up to 8 MiB; larger responses return a 502
without charg"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"ing instead of a truncated success. Endpoints that inline media (Gemini images)
declare `spooled_res"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"ponse`: their metered answer is read to a temp file instead, settled from its
reported usage, and re"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"layed whole. Authorized free final downloads needing no body
evidence stream in full, as do own-key "},{"id":"p31s8","text":"and own-tool responses."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"**Module map** (`src/treg/`):"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Module                                     | Role                                                 "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"                                                            |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| `proxy.py`                                 | `relay()` — the whole product in one function: a fait"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"hful streaming proxy                                        |
| `injectors.py`                      "},{"id":"p34s3","text":"       | the auth-shape seam: `env`, `cli_auth`, `secret_file`, `oauth` place a secret into a header"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"/query                |
| `oauth.py`                                 | token freshness (single-fligh"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"t refresh) + the connect flow (consent URL, code exchange)                          |
| `health.py` "},{"id":"p34s6","text":"                               | credential health: refresh oauth, probe tools, webhook the owner of"},{"id":"p34s7","text":" anything broken                              |
| `convert.py`                               | scaff"},{"id":"p34s8","text":"old a skill directory into a registerable bundle manifest                                           "},{"id":"p34s9","text":"        |
| `api.py`                                   | the API — the only brain; CLI + skill are t"},{"id":"p34s10","text":"hin clients over it                                                   |
| `cli.py`                  "},{"id":"p34s11","text":"                 | the `treg` CLI                                                                   "},{"id":"p34s12","text":"                                |
